characters.prompt: Create one production sprite sheet for PMA Post Mortem Arena, exactly 3 columns by 2 rows, SIX square panels of equal size edge-to-edge, 1536x1024 landscape. No gutters, no panel frames, no text or lettering. Draw each panel as a different hand-drawn 2D TV ANIME cel frame: bold clean black contour, graphic expressive anime face, flat bucket-fill colors, ONE hard-edged shadow per surface, simple drawn backgrounds, graphic hair masses. NOT realistic, NOT painterly, no textures/pores/grain/hatching/3D/bloom. Dark supernatural shounen atmosphere with vivid legible local color. Each panel reads at 64px: one focal action filling the square. Different camera angle, distance, silhouette and setting in EVERY panel, not merely different scenery. Normal coherent anatomy, exactly two arms/two legs per human, five fingers per visible hand, correct grip and contact, continuous accessories. No gore. Do not import costumes/characters from existing anime franchises. Image 1 is IDENTITY reference ONLY: preserve broad strong dark-skinned mature woman 38, square face, short silver curls, blue glass asymmetric armor, ivory scarf, gold geometric trim. Change the rendering to the strict graphic cel style of image 2 (NOT its woman/costume). Her shield is rectangular thick blue stained glass with a brass rim, fits forearm and hand grip physically. Paraíso realm, Proteção Elo: sanctuary architecture, shelter and sacrifice, cool turquoise/gold, no hell motifs. Reading order panels: 1 PORTRAIT close three-quarter face turned left at a shadowy shieldmaker workshop, shield edge low foreground. 2 PASSIVE 'Ficarei Aqui': extreme close of her armored forearm where a new translucent angular blue plate forms over a crack, frostbound sanctuary harbor behind; no floating detached hand. 3 ATTACK 'Golpe do Bastião': low SIDE view she drives her physically held shield edge into the chestplate of ONE cropped armored opponent, short impact star, stormy sanctuary lane. 4 ALLY DEFENSE 'Voto de Amparo': overhead close of her blue gauntlet placing a small protective glass facet on ONE ally's shoulder in a pine watchpost, only her arm and ally shoulder present, readable 5-finger gauntlet. 5 PIERCING COUNTER 'Resposta da Égide': dramatic target POV with shield corner approaching lens, golden straight crack-line breaking an enemy metal guard, subterranean crystal cistern, her stern eyes barely behind shield. 6 SELF INVULNERABILITY 'Fortaleza de Luz': waist-up profile she crouches entirely behind her own angled shield; incoming spear hits OUTER face far from torso, one white gold impact; windy high sanctuary pass. Never depict a group under a dome. All six coherent blue glass armor and same shield; no transparent spear through shield.
